[Visual] Workshop bench setting. Luke (black cap, dark moustache) and Joel (chevron moustache, no cap, side-parted hair) standing side-by-side at a wooden workshop bench, both looking directly down the lens, navy work shirts with sleeves rolled, dust on forearms. Behind them: pegboard with hand tools, a green cutting mat on the bench. Floating in front of them in the lower-mid frame, layered over the scene, three stacked rectangular YELLOW-ON-BLACK overlay bars reading top-to-bottom: "1. TOUGH AS NAILS" / "2. 360° VISIBILITY" / "3. FITS LIKE A GLOVE". Each bar is a clean black rectangle with the text in bold sans-serif DiggerLid yellow #f5eb19.
